items.title: How Proscia built unlimited observability with Amazon S3 and the Altinity Kubernetes Operator
items.summary: Observability can claim a growing share of IT budgets. Learn how Proscia, a pathology AI company, built a self-hosted observability platform on Amazon S3, Amazon EKS, and ClickHouse managed by the Altinity Kubernetes Operator, achieving unlimited telemetry retention at object-storage cost under HIPAA, GDPR, and data-residency requirements.
items.creator: Kyriakos Toulgaridis
